name: Major Elias Radek

conflict_flags.detail: The source flags its own discrepancy: "Earlier crew pack listed Major Elias Radek as Sentinel commander; this log uses Colonel Idris Vale as Sentinel strike lead." Both have canon records (char_elias_radek, char_idris_vale).
conflict_flags.why_unresolved: The source reports the discrepancy without settling it. The two may have led different operations, or the role may have changed hands, or one pack may supersede the other. Command of a given operation is not something to infer.

notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.
